name: Dukaan Saathi
description: Hindi voice + photo inventory & udhaar ledger for kiranas

paragraphs: A Hindi-first assistant for a small kirana (corner) shop. The owner just talks, or shows a photo of a bill, and the app keeps the two things that used to live on paper: the stock, and the udhaar, the running credit customers pay back later. It also watches the shelf, flags what is about to expire or is not selling, suggests a discount to clear slow stock, and reminds the owner to restock before a festival.

Built for the Build Small Hackathon, Backyard AI track. Everything runs on open-weight models, each well under 32B. For the demo those models are self-hosted on Modal, with no proprietary cloud AI anywhere in the loop.
